author: Mike Kasberg

mapping.sheet: Default1.6 mm rib sheet from source; range1.6–2 mm. Plinth2–2.6 mm is redesigned.
mapping.socket: Measured4.5 mm source receiving width adopted as interface scale; proposed4.5 mm male tongues not claimed measured source male width. Our sockets=(4.5+TOTAL allowance)x(sheet+TOTAL allowance), default4.65x1.75 mm.
mapping.runners: Source .21/.22 mm low planes inspire proposed .4–.6 mm high,.8–1.4 mm wide breakaway runners;12 accessible tabs.
mapping.assembly: Original horizontal plinth,two vertical parabolic ribs,four adhesive seats. Tongue length H-.2,shoulders Z=H;vertical insertion.
mapping.parabola: Original z=web+x²/(4f);64 sampled chords,aperture56–76,f14–24,vertex8–12 mm. Ideal focal line along Y atx0,z=H+web+f. Film is external,not an exported solid.
mapping.imports: Front protected radius6.5 mm signature zone,centre8 mm from front,.4–.6 mm recess,floor>=1.4 mm. Sockets outside zone.

notAReskin: No panpipe bores,collars,straws,musical cutting schedule,or horizontal collar insertion; independently reconstructed parabolic edges and vertical rib assembly. Generic studio/import/export infrastructure reused only. Not a circular loom,sundial,lens bench or periscope.
